parts.html: The K-15 standard model is a bold solution for a contemporary interior, where rich red becomes the main focal point of the composition. Clean-lined cabinets, solid-color painted fronts, and a porcelain stoneware countertop create a striking furniture ensemble that combines individual character with functionality.

A red kitchen draws the eye and creates a memorable interior without excessive decoration. This color pairs well with neutral wall tones, natural stone, wood textures, and contemporary finishing materials. Thanks to its restrained geometry, the K-15 model suits apartments, spacious condos, and private homes with open-plan layouts.

The kitchen’s defining feature is the combination of a straight layout and a separate island. The main run of cabinets accommodates built-in appliances, work surfaces, and storage along one wall. The island completes the composition, providing an additional surface for cooking and everyday tasks.
The total length of the kitchen is 6.9 linear meters. This layout makes it possible to create a fully equipped kitchen area with a well-thought-out arrangement of the main functional elements.
The upper and lower fronts are painted. The solid color emphasizes the richness of the red and preserves the integrity of the furniture composition. The carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.

The porcelain stoneware countertop complements the kitchen’s bold design and provides a practical work surface. The combination of red fronts and stone texture creates a contemporary interior with a vivid, individual character.
For ease of use, the cabinets are fitted with Hettich soft-close hinges that ensure the doors close smoothly. Atira Hettich drawers make it easy to organize kitchen utensils and accessories.
The model is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included. Lift-up mechanisms and a cargo pull-out are not included.
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-15 standard model can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room, taking into account its layout, the location of utility connections and built-in appliances, and the client’s wishes.

When developing a custom design, the size of the kitchen island, the cabinet configuration, and the placement of work surfaces can be adjusted, and the color scheme can be chosen to match the interior.
We offer a full range of services: kitchen furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
You can order the K-15 kitchen or get a personalized price quote from DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
